name: French Defense: Classical Variation, Richter Attack
description: Named after Berthold Richter, this aggressive approach features specific pawn breaks and piece activity. White pursues both kingside and queenside opportunities while Black seeks solid defense and counterplay.

name: French Defense: Classical Variation, Tartakower Variation
description: Named after Savielly Tartakower, this solid approach emphasizes piece coordination and prophylactic ideas. White maintains flexible plans while Black seeks defensive solidity with practical counterplay opportunities.
